architecture.mechanism: CNN-BiLSTM Hybrid Network with SCSSA parameter optimization for thermal error prediction
architecture.intervention: Implement a thermal error prediction system using the CNN-BiLSTM Hybrid Network optimized by SCSSA algorithm to predict spindle thermal displacement and compensate tool center point position in real-time
architecture.expected_effect: Maintain tool center point displacement below 10 micrometers across the full 20-minute warmup transient without requiring additional warmup idle cycles by preemptive compensation
architecture.falsification_test: Measure tool center point displacement during warmup cycles with and without the thermal error compensation system; compare displacement to 10-micrometer threshold across multiple warmup cycles
